messages:
tess: Heads-up: product asked for a pre-rollout "variant-cost guardrail" in the cost dashboard. Idea: automatic flagging when a variant's estimated unit cost rises > X% with > Y confidence.

omar: Nice. Two parts: (A) how we estimate unit cost from sampled telemetry + cache savings, (B) how we compute/confidence and thresholds.

li: For (A) we need event fields: model_id, variant_id, route_id, tokens_in/out, cache_saved_tokens, sample_rate, route_policy, is_canary. No prompt text. If sample_rate included we can do inverse-prob weighting.

omar: For (B) propose we maintain per-hour accumulators: weighted_sum_tokens, weighted_sum_saved, weighted_sum_sq (for variance). Use those to compute est_cost = (sum_out - sum_saved) * cost_per_token and approximate CI.

sophie: UX: show badge on variant row: green/yellow/red depending on delta + p-value. Allow user to set their own threshold in settings (default: alert if cost increases > 10% with p < 0.05). Also allow temporary mute for noisy routes.

telemetry-bot: deploy: telemetry/schema-v3-guardrail pushed to staging at 1723460000. Aggregator prototype running.

tess: We must also capture routing_policy and cohort so we can attribute increases to routing changes vs model behavior. Add rollout_id when available.

li: Sampling plan: 100% capture for billing routes + canaries. Global reservoir sample for the rest; sample_rate can be adaptive (higher for higher-priority models). Each event must include sample_rate and a small sample_tag for debug.

omar: Important: show uncertainty to users. For low effective sample_n, hide the guardrail and mark as "insufficient data". Compute effective_n = sum(1/sample_rate) and use that to gate.

sophie: Wireframe: small sparkline with shaded CI band and a mini table showing per-variant est unit cost, delta %, p-value, sample_n. Clicking row opens a timeline with cache-savings heatmap and routing annotations.

tess: Security: sensitive customers may not want variant names surfaced. Offer model_hash and allow tenant to upload mapping in private deployments. Also add console permission econ:variant_inspect.

li: Ingest optimization: for sampled events write directly to aggregator (increment counters) instead of storing raw. Keep raw traces only for 100% routes and a tiny reservoir for anomalies. Aggregator keys: hour, route, model, variant, cache_hit, route_policy. Columns: sum_w_out, sum_w_saved, sum_w_out_sq, sum_w_saved_sq, sum_w_inv.

omar: Validation: billing team will run reconciliation job that compares weighted aggregates to full-capture ground truth on a sliding 7-day window for a few tenants. If mismatch > 1% open alert.

sophie: Product ask: exportable CSV for audits including sample metadata and p-values. Also an API endpoint that returns both raw-sampled and weighted estimates for transparency.

telemetry-bot: note: ingestion-sim for sample_rates 0.1/0.5/1% scheduled (1723460100).

tess: Action items: (1) li to PR schema + aggregator counters + example inverse-weight math; (2) omar to add variance estimation code to aggregator; (3) sophie to produce guardrail wireframes and settings; (4) ops to run ingestion sim and billing reconciliation. I'll tag @billing and @product in the RFC.

tess: pinging folks: if you have objections to the default 10% / p<0.05 guardrail let's discuss in RFC — aim to avoid false positives that block rollouts.
